title: Comedy Masters
desc: Talented comedians perform humorous acts and satirical sketches to entertain a special guest and make them burst with laughter.

title: Pallavur Devanarayanan

desc: The host talks about some of the latest news stories about political, economic, social and cultural topics from all around the region.

title: Madhuchandralekha
desc: A rustic Indian woman, who loves her husband immensely, decides to unite him with a sophisticated female singer, assuming that he loves her.

desc: Johnny and Annie have four children. However, when Johnny gets killed in a brawl and Annie is diagnosed with a terminal illness, she decides to have her children adopted.

title: Dhruvam
desc: Veerasimha Mannadiar gets killed by Hyder Marakkar, a notorious criminal. Thereafter, Veerasimha's brother, Narasimha Mannadiar, decides to avenge his death.
